hypotheses.justification: Nothing in the statement or the proof uses `[W.IsElliptic]`. `IsTwoKernel` (Def_ModularCurve_WeierstrassGamma0Sqf.lean) is a structure over any `CommRing T` with three fields: `natDegree ≤ 1`, `coeff 1 = 1` and `h ∣ W.Ψ₂Sq`. `coordsOrZero` is defined for points of any affine Weierstrass curve over a commutative ring. The group law on `W.toAffine.Point`, which `addOrderOf` relies on, only needs `[Field F] [DecidableEq F]` (Mathlib Affine/Point.lean, around line 920). The first two goals are pure polynomial facts. The third goal is closed by `WeierstrassCurve.eval_Psi2Sq_of_two_nsmul_eq_zero`, whose signature is `{F} [Field F] [DecidableEq F] {W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine F} {x y} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (h2 : 2 • some h = 0)`; it does not take an `IsElliptic` instance. So the current proof still compiles after deleting the binder. `[DecidableEq F]` cannot be deleted in the same way: it is needed to elaborate the `AddCommGroup` instance behind `addOrderOf Q`, and `Classical` is not open.
